<content>
本版本在批量审批基础上新增同事务审批日志与幂等结果。只有当前已认证 approver 可以审批当前租户内他人创建的 submitted 目标，任何目标无效则全批拒绝且 Purchase/ApprovalAudit/ActionRequest 全部不变。1..100 个不重复非空字符串 ID，每项 UTF-8 长度不超过100字节，严格仅含 ids 的 JSON 对象，未知/重复字段、错误类型和无效 JSON 返回400。匿名401，requester403。认证和角色先于报文检查。最大请求体65536字节，超限413；恰好65536字节的合法输入允许。Idempotency-Key 必需且只能有一个值，长度1..128，字符集A-Z/a-z/0-9/点/下划线/冒号/连字符。成功200，响应仅 approvedIds，按UTF-8字典序排序。首次成功 Idempotency-Replayed=false；同作用域同 key、同目标集合的重放返回相同状态和响应字节，header=true，不产生新写入；同key不同目标409。作用域为 operation+tenant+actor+key。不同key不得再次审批已审批记录。每个成功目标恰好一条完整 ApprovalAudit；每个成功作用域恰好一条完成态 ActionRequest。ActionRequest.requestHash 为小写十六进制 SHA-256，输入为 "bulk-approve.v3" 加换行符，再依 UTF-8 字节序排序后的每个 ID 依次拼接 "<UTF-8字节长度>:<ID>"（无分隔符）；ActionRequest.response 为 {"approvedIds":[排序后ID]}。已确认回滚的失败不占用key；移除受控写入故障后同key可重试。网络或提交确认丢失时不保证未提交，客户端应使用同key重试以读取已提交结果。并发同key同集合两次均200，只提交一次；并发同key不同集合一个200、另一个409；不同key的重叠批次只能一个成功，败者独有目标不变。客户端上下文头不能覆盖认证身份。保留原有API行为；新日志/幂等契约仅适用于本Action，旧单条审批API未迁移。

</content>
</file>

				return protocol.Result{}, false, &protocol.Rejection{Status: 404}

		defer tx.Rollback(ctx)

		// Set up RLS context
		_, err = tx.Exec(ctx, `SELECT set_config('app.tenant',$1,true),set_config('app.user',$2,true),set_config('app.role',$3,true)`, u.Tenant, u.User, u.Role)
		if err != nil {
			return protocol.Result{}, false, err
		}

		// Calculate requestHash
		requestHash, err := calculateRequestHash(ids)
		if err != nil {
			return protocol.Result{}, false, err
		}

		// Check for existing ActionRequest with same scope but different ID set
		var existingHash string

		err = tx.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT "requestHash", response::text FROM "ActionRequest" WHERE "tenantId"=$1 AND "actorId"=$2 AND operation='bulk-approve.v3' AND key=$3`, u.Tenant, u.User, key).Scan(&existingHash, &existingResponse)
		if err == nil {
			// ActionRequest exists for this scope+key
			if existingHash != requestHash {
				// Same key, different target set -> 409
				return protocol.Result{}, false, &protocol.Rejection{Status: 409}
			}
			// Same key, same targets -> idempotent replay
			var result protocol.Result
			if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(existingResponse), &result); err != nil {
				return protocol.Result{}, false, err
			}
			return result, true, nil
		}

		// Check for any approved records in this batch with different keys
		var approvedCount int
		err = tx.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "ApprovalAudit" WHERE "tenantId"=$1 AND "purchaseId"=ANY($2::text[])`, u.Tenant, ids).Scan(&approvedCount)
		if err != nil {

		}

			return protocol.Result{}, false, &protocol.Rejection{Status: 409}
		}

				return protocol.Result{}, false, err
			}

		}

		rows.Close()
		if err != nil {
			return protocol.Result{}, false, err
		}

		if len(eligible) != len(ids) {
			return protocol.Result{}, false, &protocol.Rejection{Status: 409}
		}

		// Update all purchases to approved
		tag, err := tx.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE "Purchase" SET status='approved' WHERE id=ANY($1::text[]) AND "tenantId"=$2 AND "createdBy"<>$3 AND status='submitted'`, ids, u.Tenant, u.User)
		if err != nil {
			return protocol.Result{}, false, err

			return protocol.Result{}, false, &protocol.Rejection{Status: 409}
		}

			if err != nil {
				return protocol.Result{}, false, err
			}
		}

		// Create ActionRequest record
		responseJSON := map[string][]string{"approvedIds": ids}
		responseBytes, _ := json.Marshal(responseJSON)

		_, err = tx.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO "ActionRequest" ("tenantId","actorId",operation,key,"requestHash",response) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6)`,
			u.Tenant, u.User, "bulk-approve.v3", key, requestHash, responseBytes)
		if err != nil {
			return protocol.Result{}, false, err
		}

		// Commit transaction
		if err = tx.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
			return protocol.Result{}, false, err
		}

		return protocol.Result{ApprovedIDs: ids}, false, nil
	}
	return protocol.HTTP(approve, fallback), nil
}

// calculateRequestHash computes the SHA-256 hash of "bulk-approve.v3\n" followed by
// each sorted ID in format "<UTF-8 byte length>:<ID>"
func calculateRequestHash(ids []string) (string, error) {
	// Ensure IDs are sorted
	sortedIDs := append([]string(nil), ids...)
	sort.Strings(sortedIDs)

	hash := sha256.New()
	hash.Write([]byte("bulk-approve.v3\n"))

	for _, id := range sortedIDs {
		idBytes := []byte(id)
		byteLen := len(idBytes)
		hash.Write([]byte(fmt.Sprintf("%d:%s", byteLen, id)))
	}

	return hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil)), nil
}
